This indicates that the exception is meant to signal a precondition violation: the caller should ensure the variable name already exists before calling this update method. The execution flow is straightforward: either the precondition is met (and the method proceeds to update the mappings) or it is not (and an exception is thrown, terminating the method). The exception is used to enforce correct usage, not to signal a transient or recoverable error.
